brainlife.desc: Directory of 3D surface meshes (VTK, also PLY/STL/glTF) of tracts, FreeSurfer labels or cortical surfaces, one file per structure.
brainlife.name: neuro/3Dsurfaces

original.readme: A list of .vtk files with any names stored inside `surfaces` directory.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Visualising tract, ROI or cortical surfaces in 3D viewers. Shape analysis such as Laplace-Beltrami spectra of each mesh.

**Not for:** Voxel-wise analysis; meshes carry geometry only, not image intensities. Cross-subject comparison without a common space; meshes stay in the source image space.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 6 Apps, output of 5 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.3Dsurfaces.json
